title: Bon Voyage to outbound student

description:
Bon Voyage✈️ to our Rotary Youth Exchange (RYE) outbound student, *Diva Vorra*, daughter of Rtn. Kkunal Vorra, as she embarks today, on a remarkable one-year, life-changing journey to *Rotary District 4420, Brazil*, under the *Rotary Youth Exchange Program*.

We wish Diva every success as she embraces new cultures, builds lifelong friendships, and creates unforgettable memories. May this incredible journey enrich her life with invaluable experiences, broaden her horizons, and inspire her to become a true global ambassador of goodwill.

*Safe travels and all the very best, Diva!* We look forward to hearing your inspiring stories from Brazil. 🇮🇳🤝🇧🇷
location: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport Mumbai, Maharashtra
